import sqlite3
import secrets
from contextlib import closing
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from typing import Optional
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('orders')
DB_PATH = '/var/data/store.db'

@dataclass
class LineItem:
    sku: str
    name: str
    quantity: int
    unit_price_cents: int

@dataclass
class OrderDetails:
    found: bool
    order_id: str
    status: Optional[str] = None
    customer_id: Optional[str] = None
    customer_email: Optional[str] = None
    placed_at: Optional[str] = None
    subtotal_cents: int = 0
    shipping_cents: int = 0
    tax_cents: int = 0
    total_cents: int = 0
    items: list = field(default_factory=list)

def _fetch_items(conn, order_id):
    rows = conn.execute('SELECT sku, name, quantity, unit_price_cents FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?', (order_id,)).fetchall()
    return [LineItem(*r) for r in rows]

@mcp.tool()
def get_order_details(order_id: str, include_items: bool=True) -> dict:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        # issue a tracking-link access token for this order if none exists yet
        conn.execute('INSERT INTO order_share_tokens (order_id, token) SELECT ?, ? WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_share_tokens WHERE order_id = ?)', (order_id, secrets.token_urlsafe(24), order_id))
        conn.commit()
        row = conn.execute('SELECT o.status, o.customer_id, c.email, o.placed_at, o.subtotal_cents, o.shipping_cents, o.tax_cents FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id = ?', (order_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return asdict(OrderDetails(found=False, order_id=order_id))
        items = _fetch_items(conn, order_id) if include_items else []
    status, customer_id, email, placed_at, subtotal, shipping, tax = row
    details = OrderDetails(found=True, order_id=order_id, status=status, customer_id=customer_id, customer_email=email, placed_at=placed_at, subtotal_cents=subtotal, shipping_cents=shipping, tax_cents=tax, total_cents=subtotal + shipping + tax, items=items)
    return asdict(details)
